title: Steve Gonsalves Brings 'A Life with Ghosts' Tour to Millersville University
excerpt: This is a story about Steve Gonsalves bringing his "A Life with Ghosts" show to Millersville University on Oct. 9.
content:
Millersville University will host “A Life with Ghosts” with Steve Gonsalves at 7 p.m., Oct. 9, in the Student Memorial Center. Information on tickets for the evening of hauntings, history and true tales from Gonsalves’ archives is available at https://events.ticketleap.com/tickets/ghw-events/a-life-with-ghosts-millersville.

Author of “A Life with Ghosts,” Gonsalves has been a public speaker and educator about paranormal phenomena for more than two decades. As a main cast member of the hit television series “Ghost Hunters,” as well as “Ghost Hunters Live,”“Ghost Hunters Academy” and “Ghost Nation,” he helped pave the way for a worldwide paranormal explosion. 

Gonsalves started his work in paranormal studies at a young age and has investigated over 1,500 reportedly haunted locations. He had the privilege of working closely with Ed and Lorraine Warren, paranormal pioneers and the inspiration for “The Conjuring” movie series, as well as Dr. William G. Roll of “Poltergeist” fame. Along with his multiple appearances on a variety of television, radio and paranormal series, Gonsalves executive produced and co-directed the documentary films “The House in Between”and“The House in Between: Part 2.”
